tests.title: Battery power-on reaches Home with readings
tests.objective: Verify that an onboarded device starts from a fully powered-off state on battery power and displays Home with sensor readings.
setup: Onboarding has already been completed.

steps.action: Select Main Menu > Operating Mode > Portable, then disconnect USB.
steps.expected_result: Portable mode is selected and USB is disconnected.

steps.action: Hold Power until Powered off is fully displayed, release Power, and wait 10 seconds.
steps.expected_result: Powered off remains displayed; the device does not restart by itself.

steps.action: Press and release Power. Observe startup for up to five minutes from the Power press.
steps.expected_result: Getting Ready is fully displayed, followed by Home without showing Getting Started. Home shows numeric PM2.5 and CO2 readings and a battery indicator, with no missing text or leftover content from the shutdown or startup screens.
evidence: Save a Home photo. If a refresh stalls or leaves an incomplete screen, capture a video.

setup: All routes, charts, settings and bonds on this unit are expendable.

steps.action: Disconnect USB. Hold BOOT for at least two seconds to factory-reset, then release. Allow 30 seconds from release for Getting Started to appear.
steps.expected_result: Getting Started is visible after restart.

steps.action: On Getting Started, tap Menu once, quickly double-tap Menu, then hold Menu for about half a second and release. Pause and inspect the screen after each gesture.
steps.expected_result: Getting Started remains open after each gesture.

steps.action: Hold Menu for at least one second, keeping it held until Home appears; then release.
steps.expected_result: Home appears unlocked while Menu is still held. Releasing Menu leaves Home open.

steps.action: Hold Power until Powered off is fully displayed, release Power, and wait 10 seconds. Press and release Power to start, allowing up to five minutes from this press for Home to appear.
steps.expected_result: The device reaches Home without showing Getting Started.

cleanup: If interrupted, complete onboarding by holding Menu on Getting Started. If this fails, record that the device remains on Getting Started.

Send PUT http://airgradient_<serial>.local/api/v1/config with No Auth and Content-Type: application/json.
